dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct white horizontal bands across the greater and median coverts exhibiting high grayscale contrast against dark gray-blue feathering.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High boundary sharpness; prominent white linear edges are clearly visible along the margins of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A narrow, horizontal linear band of high-contrast black positioned at the base of the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp and distinct black boundary line separates the white plumage of the nape from the uniform gray plumage of the mantle.
